sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Replace the in-lieu NOT EXISTS readiness SPARQL with SHACL Core conditional constraints, leaving only the bounded formula query. Prevent accidental pass/ambiguous evaluation by making frameProfileType and every formula quantity single-valued (sh:maxCount 1), and make each quantity unit single-valued so sh:hasValue cannot pass a quantity that also carries another unit. Preserve the existing class-plus-inLieuOfFrame=true applicability and formula directions/thresholds.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph omits the required in-lieu alternative for a deck, tank top, tank bottom, or bulkhead: its plate thickness must use adjacent frame height and C = 805. Locate and use the canonical plate-thickness quantity property, then add applicability constrained by the supplied structure classes and nltl:inLieuOfFrame true. Keep the profile/flat-bar branch with C = 805/282, but target it from the constrained thickness entity rather than only subjects already having frameProfileType, which currently lets missing profile evidence escape validation. Require the applicable operands and enforce positive adjacent frame height so the current ?height > 0 guard cannot silently skip the formula; compare the measured thickness against all three minima: h_w*sqrt(sigma_y)/C, (t-t_c)/2, and 9 mm.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: SHACL runtime smoke execution error: Expected SelectQuery, found 'FILTER'  (at char 504), (line:13, col:17) | Embedded SHACL-SPARQL parse error: Expected SelectQuery, found 'FILTER'  (at char 682), (line:18, col:17) | Embedded SHACL-SPARQL parse error: Expected SelectQuery, found 'FILTER'  (at char 347), (line:9, col:17)
Semantic validator feedback: Deterministic validation is invalid. Rewrite all three `FILTER NOT EXISTS { ... }` expressions as parser-supported `FILTER (NOT EXISTS { ... })` and rerun validation. Avoid non-standard bare `SQRT`; use a supported function or an algebraically equivalent squared inequality with the existing nonnegative guards. Also target ordinary-frame candidates via `frameProfileType` as well as `frameWebThickness`, because targeting only subjects already having `frameWebThickness` lets a missing required web thickness escape validation. Preserve the two alternatives, coefficients 805/282, `(netShellPlatingThickness - corrosionAbrasionAddition) / 2`, 9 mm minimum, and the metre-to-millimetre conversion for in-lieu plate thickness.

Replace the in-lieu NOT EXISTS readiness SPARQL with SHACL Core conditional constraints, leaving only the bounded formula query. Prevent accidental pass/ambiguous evaluation by making frameProfileType and every formula quantity single-valued (sh:maxCount 1), and make each quantity unit single-valued so sh:hasValue cannot pass a quantity that also carries another unit. Preserve the existing class-plus-inLieuOfFrame=true applicability and formula directions/thresholds.
